scenarios.name: Mirror March creates one token copy for each flip won before the first lost flip
scenarios.ruling: Flipping continues until a flip is lost, and one token copy of the creature that entered is created for each won flip. The tokens are tokens, so they do not trigger the ability again. The engine's flip sequence wins five times before its first loss, so five 2/2 copies of Grizzly Bears join the original.

expect.log: creates a token copy of Grizzly Bears
flips a coin for Mirror March: tails \(loses the flip\)

scenarios.name: Mirror March's token copies gain haste and can attack the turn they are created
scenarios.ruling: The tokens gain haste, so they can attack the turn they are created; the nontoken Grizzly Bears cast this turn cannot. Five hasty 2/2 copies deal 10 damage.

scenarios.name: Mirror March exiles its token copies at the beginning of the next end step
scenarios.ruling: The delayed triggered ability exiles the tokens in the next end step; a token in a zone other than the battlefield ceases to exist (CR 111.7), so exile ends up empty and only the nontoken creature that entered is left.

expect.log: creates a token copy of Grizzly Bears

scenarios.name: Mirror March does not trigger for a creature an opponent controls
scenarios.ruling: The ability triggers only for a nontoken creature its controller controls, so an opponent's creature entering flips no coins and creates no tokens.

expect.noLog: flips a coin for Mirror March
